deploy-bot: [STAGING] Deploy started for service=runtime-api env=staging tag=release/v2.8.1-staging commit=abc1234 run_id=deploy-2101234567 change_window=2026-03-19T14:00Z-15:00Z rolling_plan=canary(3 hosts) -> ramp by pct. Notifying: @emma @raj @marta.

emma: ack — starting smoke tests and watching kv/cache health. will update within 5m.

raj: note: this deploy includes a KV cache init reorder change; watch for 503s & init timeouts. added a smoke check for kv-init.

marta: smoke started — command: ```./infra/smoke.sh --env=staging --checks=health,kv-init,generate``` 

oncall-ops: observing a spike of 503s on canary host rtm-03 at 14:05:12: `kvcache init timeout` repeated 3x.

emma: pausing rollout. holding at ~12% traffic. asking ops to investigate host rtm-03.

deploy-bot: Rollout PAUSED at 12% by @emma. To resume: `/deploy resume 2101234567`. To rollback: `/deploy rollback 2101234567 --to-tag release/v2.7.9`. Pin recommended if hold > 10m.

raj: digging in — rtm-03 shows NTP drift causing agent handshake to time out; restarting agent now. attaching logs: ```ERROR 14:05:10 kvcache: init deadline exceeded``` 

marta: smoke results so far: kv-init failing on rtm-03, other canaries OK. holding further ramps.

emma: decision: do not auto-rollback yet. schedule pin to v2.7.9 as a quick mitigation if issue persists beyond 10m. I'll monitor.

deploy-bot: Pin scheduled: service=runtime-api pinned_to=release/v2.7.9 at 2026-03-19T14:12Z by emma. Use `/deploy cancel-pin 2101234567` to cancel.

oncall-ops: agent restart completed on rtm-03 at 14:18:43, kv-init success after restart. tail of logs: `kvcache initialized in 1.2s`

emma: ok — canceling the pin. let's resume a constrained canary (3 hosts) and keep a short watch for latency.

deploy-bot: Canary RESUMED at 3 hosts. Ramp plan: 5% -> 20% over 5m.

zoe: running regression suite now, will post results.

marta: regression looks green aside from one latency blip: /generate 1200ms at 14:26:11, baseline was 400-600ms.

raj: confirmed the blip corresponds to transient GC on one host. no error codes. ok to continue ramp.

emma: continue -> shift to 50% traffic. notify if we see repeat latency spikes.

deploy-bot: Traffic ramped to 50%.

ci-bot: smoke checks summary: 23 passed, 1 flaky (latency blip under attention).

deploy-bot: DEPLOY COMPLETED for service=runtime-api env=staging tag=release/v2.8.1-staging commit=abc1234 run_id=deploy-2101234567 duration=26m status=COMPLETED url=https://deploy.redwood/internal/deploys/2101234567

emma: filing quick release note: "staging: runtime-api v2.8.1-staging — KV cache init reorder + perf tweaks. Canary paused due to NTP drift on one host, recovered after agent restart; resumed and completed. Observed one transient latency blip."

marta: added note to changelog and marked change-window closed.

oncall-ops: change-window: CLOSED :white_check_mark: — monitored until 15:00Z.

raj: thanks team :thumbsup:

zoe: will add the flaky latency case to the ticket for follow-up on heap/GC tuning.
